messages:
maya-sales: Lighthouse Health asked for a short perf POC next week. Goals: sustain 300 qps, p95 < 350ms, p99 < 700ms, show coldstart behavior, and CMK for embeddings. Need runbook + one-page cost estimate.

ivan-eng: Sequence samples? avg tokens?

maya-sales: They sent traces: ~210 in, ~120 out, ~70% session reuse.

ivan-eng: Prefetch/prefix caching will help. Rough token rate = 300*(210+120)=~99k tok/s. With our quantized medium ~12k tok/s per GPU => ~8-9 GPUs. Batching cap 20ms recommended.

toni-ops: Draft runbook snippet:
```
- Provision 9 GPUs (min 6 / max 12 autoscale by token/s)
- Enable KV cache, batching cap=20ms, session affinity
- Traffic: session-aware Poisson, 30m steady @300 qps, 10m 3x bursts
- Coldstart: 5 restarts during soak
- Security: trigger CMK rotation and verify audit logs
```

ben-sre: kms-bot: "CMK SUPPORT: customer-managed keys available on Dedicated/Private. Hosted uses envelope encryption; for in-path CMK recommend Dedicated in same VPC."

mia-qa: I'll run p50/p95/p99, tokens/s, GPU util, queuing, and KMS latency. Add a hosted control run to show delta.

maya-sales: Procurement wants 12mo committed quote and 1mo hosted PoC price. Toni, can you ballpark?

toni-ops: Preliminary ballpark: Dedicated (9 GPUs reserved + infra/support) ~$78k/month. Hosted 1mo PoC (managed, logs): ~$26k. Will refine after infra sizing.

ben-sre: Note: sync KMS calls can add ~10-20ms if cross-region; in-VPC CMK ~5-10ms. Recommend short-lived DEKs or async wrapping to avoid critical path.

maya-sales: Timeline: runbook final Mon EOD, infra Tue, run Wed-Thu, results Fri. I'll share with Lighthouse and loop in security. :thumbsup:
